hero-vietnamese-table.png.prompt: Use case: compositing. Asset type: restaurant website hero background, wide 16:9 landscape. Use the three supplied restaurant food photographs as food references: beef pho in a black bowl, three golden fried Vietnamese spring rolls with cabbage salad and sauce, and the assorted sushi platter. Create one cohesive photorealistic overhead editorial food photograph on a warm dark charcoal restaurant table. Arrange the black pho bowl prominently along the left edge, the spring roll plate towards the upper right corner, and a modest sushi platter along the lower right edge, preserving the actual recognizable food ingredients and character of the sources. Leave the central 40 percent of the frame as spacious clean dark table negative space for a centered website headline and buttons; do not put dishes or props in the center. Beautiful natural soft directional light, appetizing fresh herbs, rich natural golden food tones, believable ceramic textures and soft contact shadows. A little ginger, wakame, soy sauce and wasabi in a tiny ceramic condiment bowl beside the sushi, with minimal clutter. Camera straight overhead, polished professional restaurant food photography, generous composed framing, food near the edges with some deliberate cropping. No text, lettering, logos, watermark, decorative smoke, hands or invented branding. Deliver a standalone photographic background only, not a website mockup.

hero-sushi.png.prompt: Use case: compositing. Edit the supplied actual restaurant sushi photograph into a wide 16:9 restaurant website hero photo. Preserve the existing sushi assortment, types, proportions and every sushi piece, do not invent extra sushi. Place the original assortment on a matte charcoal rectangular ceramic serving platter across the right two-thirds. Add realistic modest accompaniments: pink pickled ginger, a small mound of wasabi, a small bowl of green wakame seaweed salad and a black dipping dish of soy sauce beside the sushi. Background is a dark warm charcoal restaurant table with softly lit food, natural appetizing professional food photography. Leave left third spacious dark negative space for website copy. No text, logos, decorative smoke, chopstick clutter, borders or watermark. Output image for the local website project; save available file.

sushi-accompaniments.png.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Website food photography asset, transparent background. A compact horizontal row of four realistic tiny sushi accompaniments in a single arrangement: pale pink pickled ginger on a tiny dark ceramic saucer on the left, a small green wasabi mound, a small black ceramic bowl of bright green wakame seaweed salad sprinkled with sesame, and a small shallow black ceramic dish filled with dark soy sauce on the right. Professional realistic close-up food photo, camera 45 degrees down matching sushi catalog photography. Entire objects visible with ample transparent margin, no table, no sushi, no background, no text, no labels, no chopsticks, no logos. Objects sit on the same baseline; warm neutral soft lighting, no exaggerated shadows. Must have genuinely transparent alpha around all four objects. Wide horizontal composition about 3:1 with tightly bounded objects.
